Also, every time I try to talk to her about a boyfriend problem or something, she makes it her problem and I always end up holding her until she can't stop crying. To stop myself from hurting her, I had to sit alone for 15 minutes to calm down. I've tried talking to him in many different ways from different angles, but he always gets irritated or withdraws. I've been to a therapist about this problem and I'm still very confused.
Stručno mi je dijagnosticiran ADHD s koj: I was professionally diagnosed with ADHD, which I have struggled with since childhood. I was later diagnosed with Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) and Generalized Personality Disorder (GAD), and another doctor diagnosed me with BD2. I am certain about BPD and ADHD, but I think I actually have Multiple Personality Disorder (MPD) (not GAD and BD2) and I am worried. I always hate telling my parents or doctors about the problems I think I have because I am afraid I will seem dramatic or that I "want to have problems." I fit every description in the DSM5, but when I think of MPD, I immediately picture Sybil from the movie and know that I am not nearly as serious as she is. Već gotovo dvije godine borim se sa sve: I have been struggling with worsening anxiety symptoms for almost two years now. I also constantly go through a mental list of tasks, appointments, and events, and I copy the list into my planner every day. Usually I just go through the list in my head, but I have also noticed that I will talk to myself out loud as I walk to and from class and go through the list as I make a plan of what order I will complete these tasks in. I go through this order multiple times, usually until I get to wherever I am going or meet other people because I worry that I will be judged for talking to myself. Even when I do complete the tasks I set out to do that day, I still think about the items on that list and panic about how much I still have to do. As a result, I feel like I can never fully relax. I'm always worried that I'll forget something on that list and that something bad will happen because I don't finish that particular thing. I also have a hard time concentrating because I'm constantly thinking about these things. When I'm having a hard time concentrating and feeling really anxious about something, I generally feel a tightness in my chest and shortness of breath, and I end up picking at the skin around my nails, and on particularly bad days I do it until they bleed. Although I'm generally afraid that others will judge me for my actions, picking helps me calm down and refocus. Although my worries about school are mostly my main focus, I also often worry about my relationships, especially that my friends don't really like me and that I don't really have feelings for my boyfriend. I've recently started to worry that I have OCD, not just anxiety. I've mentioned some of these topics to my doctor, but should I express my concern that the anxiety I'm feeling reflects some aspects of OCD? (From the USA)

It's horrible. Also, every time I try to contact one of these people now, they seem to ignore me as if I never even said hello.
